info.title: Generosity API
info.description: PHP/MySQL backend. Requests and responses are UTF-8 JSON. UTC timestamps; expiry dates are inclusive UTC days. Bearer-only authentication (7-day tokens); no cookie authentication. Idempotency keys are per-account UUIDs retained with committed operations. Same-key retries replay the exact success after current authorization; changed validated content conflicts. Need status denotes publication, not native lifecycle: clients derive covered/expired using quantities and expiry. Money is never accepted. No incremental sync contract yet.
